subject: Ciências
description_pt: Analisar historicamente o uso da tecnologia, incluindo a digital, nas diferentes dimensões da vida humana, considerando indicadores ambientais e de qualidade de vida.

components.description_pt: Analisar, sob perspectiva histórica, como a tecnologia foi usada nas dimensões da vida humana
components.description_en: Analyze, from a historical perspective, how technology has been used across dimensions of human life
components.cc_component_description: Compare historical and current magnitudes of human impacts on Earth's systems

components.description_pt: Avaliar a relação entre desenvolvimento tecnológico e indicadores ambientais
components.description_en: Evaluate the relationship between technological development and environmental indicators
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between human population growth and increased consumption of natural resources

components.description_pt: Avaliar o impacto da tecnologia digital em indicadores de qualidade de vida ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Assess the impact of digital technology on quality-of-life indicators over time
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data showing trends in human impact scale over time

cc_matches.description: Though the magnitudes of human impacts are greater than they have ever been, so too are human abilities to model, predict, and manage current and future impacts.
Typically as human populations and per-capita consumption of natural resources increase, so do the negative impacts on Earth unless the activities and technologies involved are engineered otherwise.
